question.prompt: One diagonal of a rhombus has length 24, and its side length is 13. Find the length of the other diagonal.

solutions.explanation: The diagonals bisect each other at right angles. Half of one diagonal is 12, and half of the other is \(\sqrt{13^2-12^2}=5\), so the other diagonal has length 10.
solutions.title: Find and double the unknown half-diagonal
